rule: Inventory of files present in MULA-MUTHA-3D. Mandovi measurements are not listed as sources. Unavailable parameters are not stored as zero.

datasets.name: BOD/COD pixel grid
datasets.dataType: point samples [lon, lat, BOD mg/L, COD mg/L]
datasets.coverage: Mula–Mutha study overlay, about 73.855–73.993 E, 18.521–18.547 N
datasets.legend: Numeric BOD and COD. Good/moderate/high bands used only as labels: BOD ≤3 / ≤6 / >6 mg/L, COD ≤10 / ≤30 / >30 mg/L.
datasets.availability: 1212 points inside the study bounds (file count 1217 before the bound filter)
datasets.provenance: source field streams_bod_cod_pixels.kml, also src/jalnetra kml/streams_bod_cod_pixels.kml

datasets.name: Eutrophication trophic class
datasets.units: chlorophyll-a class (µg/L) and TSI band, not a point concentration
datasets.timestamp: file meta updated 2026-11-11; laboratory observation time is not in the file
datasets.availability: overlay present; sampled pixels are eutrophic and hypereutrophic only
datasets.provenance: JalNetra KML. Companion meta public/data/hydrology/pollution/eutrophication/meta.json. Raster overlay.png is not in the repo; the PNG is embedded in the KML.

datasets.name: Nitrogen risk class
datasets.coverage: same study bounds as the eutrophication overlay
datasets.availability: overlay present; most sampled pixels are High
datasets.provenance: JalNetra KML. meta public/data/hydrology/pollution/nitrogen/meta.json. A second file src/jalnetra kml/nitrogen_risk_class.kml exists and was not used; the hydrology layer meta points at Nitrogen mulamutha.kml.

datasets.name: Coliform / E. coli class
datasets.units: relative class band. Not a counted CFU/100 ml value.
datasets.legend: Good ≤250, Moderate 260–500, High 500–2000, Highly risk >2000, all marked relative
datasets.availability: overlay present; Good, Moderate, High and Highly risk pixels all occur

datasets.name: JalNetra BOD/COD reach API
datasets.dataType: live or cached reach sample by chainage
datasets.coverage: Mula–Mutha reaches served by the existing viewer API
datasets.crs: chainage metres on the project centreline
datasets.timestamp: per response date when the API returns a row
datasets.availability: used by the weather widget when a reach sample exists. Not copied into the hotspot JSON.

datasets.name: Chlorophyll-a concentration raster
datasets.availability: no separate chlorophyll raster or station table

datasets.name: Nitrogen concentration
datasets.availability: no mg N/L table. Risk class only.

datasets.name: Coliform count
datasets.availability: no counted CFU table. Relative class only.

datasets.name: TSS
datasets.units: mg/L where that layer publishes them
datasets.availability: kept as its own GIS layer. Excluded from the hotspot composite.
